title: Reception of the RRCReject by the UE

entities.name: RRCReject
entities.description: RRC message sent by the network to reject an RRC connection request from the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives the RRCReject message and performs subsequent actions.

entities.name: Actions specified in clause 5.3.15
entities.description: The set of actions that the UE must perform upon receiving RRCReject, as detailed in clause 5.3.15 of TS 38.331.

relations.description: The UE performs actions upon reception of the RRCReject message.
The UE shall perform the actions specified in clause 5.3.15.
